check.title: An outreach domain is configured
check.detail: OUTREACH_FROM is unset or carries no @domain. Nothing can be checked without it.

check.title: A DKIM selector is configured
check.detail: OUTREACH_DKIM_SELECTOR is unset. DKIM is selector-scoped and there is no safe default — set the selector the ESP issued (Resend uses resend, Google Workspace google).

check.title: The outreach domain is distinct from the transactional one
check.detail: Outreach sends from (unset), transactional from advo.ph.
